title: Finite-amplitude stationary de Sitter shell closure with paired quantum sources
scope: Dimensionless mathematical model family; no physical parameter inference, dynamical evolution, quantum stability or EFT certification

normalization.interpretation: gamma=g5 for this explicit one-field model family; gamma=0 is the classical control; high gamma is a formal closure stress test

state: Euclidean/Bunch-Davies de Sitter invariant vacuum of one free massive minimally coupled shell scalar
finite_matching: Inherited DESITTER common-action finite convention at fixed positive r; every retained local term occurs exactly once

newton.retry_policy: Record failed point and continue registered cases with last successful seed; no new grid, tolerance or parameter tuning

reporting: Every requested point, failure and control is retained. Differences use each resolution's own solved gamma-zero control. Numerically resolved shifts and nonlinear departures are classified separately from solver acceptance. No confidence/interval certification. No extension beyond the registered grid if feedback is unresolved.
